chunks: Abu al-Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad narrated from Muhammad ibn Abdillah, from al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Zakariyya, from al-Haytham ibn Abdillah, from al-Rida Ali ibn Musa (peace be upon him), from his father, who said:
Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: "Indeed, the days of the visitors of al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him) are not counted among their fixed lifespans."
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of visiting Imam al-Husayn regarding one's lifespan?
ai.summary: In the *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), establishing the theological principle that pilgrimage to Imam al-Husayn (AS) suspends the countdown of one's allotted lifespan (*ajal*). This signifies that such visits are not merely a consumption of time but a divine grace that extends life or adds to one's spiritual merit, reflecting the high status of *Ziyarat* in Shia jurisprudence and spirituality.
